cases.question: Quels facteurs expliquent le score de la région 32 en 2025-02 ?

SELECT
  sf.indicator_code,
  sf.contribution,
  r.score AS overall_score
FROM analytics_score_factors sf
LEFT JOIN analytics_risk_scores r
  ON sf.geographic_level = r.geographic_level
  AND sf.geographic_code = r.geographic_code
  AND sf.reference_period = r.reference_period
WHERE sf.geographic_code = '32'
  AND sf.reference_period = '2025-02'
ORDER BY sf.contribution DESC;
